name: rosillo-ai-platform
description: Rosillo AI Platform — Client AI Insurance Concierge + Employee Copilot handoff on one governed platform. SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p packages/audit && tsc -p packages/store && tsc -p packages/auth && tsc -p packages/customer-360 && tsc -p packages/retrieval && tsc -p packages/ai && tsc -p packages/actions && tsc -p packages/orchestration && tsc -p packages/evals && tsc -p packages/brand && tsc -p packages/i18n && tsc -p apps/client-concierge && tsc -p apps/employee-copilot
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rosillo/client-concierge && npm run build -w @rosillo/employee-copilot
scripts.db:migrate: for f in supabase/migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f"; done
